units.source_text: 源氏公子心中大约在想：在上品的女子中，称心的美人也不易多得，世事真不可解啊！

en.t: Prince Genji was probably thinking to himself: even among women of the highest rank, truly pleasing beauties are not easy to find; the ways of the world are hard to understand indeed!

units.source_text: 此时他身穿一套柔软的白衬衣，外面随意地披上一件常礼服，带子也不系。

en.t: At that moment he was wearing a soft white undergarment, with an ordinary formal robe thrown loosely over it, and even his sash left untied.

units.source_text: 在灯火影中，这姿态非常昳丽，几令人误认为美女。

en.t: In the lamplight and shadows, his figure looked so graceful and beautiful that one could almost mistake him for a lovely woman.

units.source_text: 为这美貌公子择配，即使选得上品中之上品的女子，似乎还够不上呢。

en.t: To choose a bride for this beautiful prince, even a woman selected from the very finest of the highest rank would still seem hardly good enough.
